name: Quail Hollow RV Park
note: Small RV park beside Lake of Three Fires State Park north of Bedford: 19 sites in three areas, full-hookup sites $40 and water/electric $30 a night, three water/electric sites by the pond $50. Online booking (Firefly). RV Life 5*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: qhrvpark.com live with a per-site rate list (FHU $40, W/E $30, read 2026-10-02) and Firefly online booking; RV Life 5* $$ over 1 review, Google 4.8 over 19 with phone (read 2026-10-02) - thin but every signal positive
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 40.7196,-94.6765: the RV loop sits on open ground east of the office; the pond the three 'Water's Edge' sites face is ~50 m off the pads and the rest of the park is away from water; default down - not waterfront

name: Trailhead Cabins and Camping
note: Four full-hookup RV sites (three 50-amp, one 30-amp) beside a small pond with cabins, south of Steamboat Rock near the Iowa River greenbelt; $35 a night ($25 on the 30-amp site). RV Life 4.5*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: trailheadcnc.com live with a camping page listing four full-hookup sites at $35/$25 and online booking (read 2026-10-02); RV Life 4.5* $$ over 2 reviews, Google 5.0 over 37 with phone (read 2026-10-02)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 42.4041,-93.0805: the sites ring a small decorative pond beside the buildings; the Iowa River is ~250 m south behind a treeline and fields - not waterfront

name: Wild Oak Campground
note: Year-round full-hookup RV park (20/30/50-amp) on the north side of Story City: $45 a night, weekly and monthly rates, laundry, restrooms and showers. Reservations by text, call or email. Many long-stay guests. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: wildoakcampground.com live: daily $45, weekly $240, monthly $620, full hookups (read 2026-10-02); RV Life 4* $$ over 12 reviews, Google 4.0 over 137 (read 2026-10-02); long-stay-leaning but publishes a nightly rate and takes overnighters (GA Dogwood rule)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 42.1928,-93.5764: gravel rows of RV pads in an open wooded lot east of the Skunk River's wooded bottom, ~250 m from the river - not waterfront

name: DeSoto Bend RV Resort
note: Family-owned park on US-30 west of Missouri Valley, near DeSoto National Wildlife Refuge: 15 back-in full-hookup sites (50-amp), Starlink wifi, $35 a night or $220 a week; books by phone. Short and long stays. Formerly DeSoto RV Campground. RV Life 4*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: desotobendrvresort.com live: 15 full-hookup sites, $35/night, phone booking (read 2026-10-02); RV Life 4* $$ over 4 reviews (as DeSoto R V Campground). Was id 3196, removed 2026-09 for no live web presence - it now has its own site
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 41.5520,-96.0291: a small treed lot of pads north of US-30 surrounded by cropland; DeSoto Lake is ~2 km west - not waterfront

name: Loess Hills Hideaway Cabins & Campground
note: Cabins and a six-site campground in Loess Hills woodland near Preparation Canyon State Park: grassy sites with gravel pads and 35-amp electric, fits ~32 ft, no water fill or sewer (dump in Pisgah). RV or tent $45 a night for two adults. Open all year; CampLife booking. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: loesshillshideaways.com live: campground page (6 electric sites, ~32 ft) and rates page RV/Tent $45 for 1-2 adults (read 2026-10-02); unrated on RV Life; Google 4.8 over 77 with phone (read 2026-10-02)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 41.8656,-95.8513: a gravel loop of sites in an opening in hillside woods; the only water is a creek-side pond ~350 m east across the road - not waterfront

name: Whispering Maples Campground
note: Small family campground on a farmstead northwest of Wapello, sites under trees; listed on RV Life as Papa's Paradise Campground (RV Life 4.5*/$$, ~35 sites). No website; call ahead. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Google listing open at the pin with phone, 4.7 over 44 (read 2026-10-02) - passes the 2026-10-01 Google-listing rule; RV Life (as Papa's Paradise) 4.5* $$ avg ~$23 over 3 reviews - price passes on tier
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 240 m frame) at 41.2405,-91.1935: sandy pads under a block of trees beside the farm buildings; a farm pond ~120 m west is not at the sites - not waterfront

name: Beaver Lake Campground
note: Small private campground south of Beaver Lake near Dexter: water/30-amp electric sites and a dump station in a loop by the shower house. No website; call ahead. RV Life 4*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Google listing open with phone, 3.8 over 39 (read 2026-10-02; reviewers cite water, 30-amp and dump) - passes the 2026-10-01 Google-listing rule; RV Life 4* $$ avg ~$28 over 12 reviews - price and quality pass on RV Life
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 41.5284,-94.2147: three gravel loops in a mown lot across the road from the lake's grassy south shore; the water is ~200 m north beyond scrub - not waterfront

name: Olde Massey Station Campground & RV Park
note: Small family campground under new ownership since 2023 in the valley south of Dubuque, a half mile from the Mississippi and a boat landing; live music on summer weekends. Reservations by phone or email. RV Life 4*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: oldemassey.com live, reservations by call/email (read 2026-10-02); RV Life 4* $$ avg ~$32 over 6 reviews; Google 4.4 over 31 with phone (read 2026-10-02)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 42.4305,-90.5982: a single gravel loop with a dozen rigs above the valley road; a creek runs ~100 m south beyond the road and trees - not waterfront

name: Bluffton Resort & Bar
note: Campground with a bar and grill and canoe/kayak/tube rentals on the Upper Iowa River at Bluffton, northwest of Decorah: about 59 RV sites, 30/50-amp electric and a few full hookups, season May 1 - Oct 31. Campspot booking; 30-amp sites $48 on an October 2026 weeknight. Owns White's Riverside across the river (now 'Kenny's Corner'). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: blufftonresort.com live with Campspot booking; Campspot live quote Wed 2026-10-07: back-in 30-amp site $48, 50-amp/FHU $58 - passes the $50 published-rate gate (read 2026-10-02); not on RV Life (Good-Sam-only, general 6.3); Google 4.3 over 250 and Campspot 4.3 over 25 verified reviews
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 43.4026,-91.9137: sites spread around the bar and office on open ground; the Upper Iowa River is 150-200 m west and south behind trees, and the operator's own site descriptions say 'near water but not waterfront' - not waterfront
